verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων,

verses.geez:
ንሥኦ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወለደቂቁ ፡ ወአልባሲሆሙኒ ፡ ወቅብአ ፡ ዘይትቀብኡ ፡ ወላህመ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ወክልኤተ ፡
                  አባግዐ ፡ ወመስፈርተ ፡ ናእት ።
verses.translation: Take Aaron and his sons, and his robes and the anointing oil, and the calf for the sin-offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread,

translations.lxx: Take Aaron and his sons, and his robes and the anointing oil, and the calf for the sin-offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread,
translations.kjv: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
translations.ron: "Ia pe Aaron şi împreună cu el şi pe fiii lui, veşmintele, mirul de miruit, viţelul de jertfa cea pentru păcat, panerul cu azimile şi cei doi berbeci,
translations.grk: λάβε Ἀαρὼν καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰς στολὰς αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον τῆς χρίσεως, καὶ τὸν μόσχον τὸν περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας, καὶ τοὺς δύο κριοὺς, καὶ τὸ κανοῦν τῶν ἀζύμων,

verses.geez: ወአስተራክብ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ተዓይነ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኆኅተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: and assemble the whole congregation at the door of the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: and assemble the whole congregation at the door of the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.ron: Şi adună toată obştea la uşa cortului adunării".
translations.grk: καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν συναγωγὴν ἐκκλησίασον ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου.

verses.geez: ወገብረ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወአስተራከበ ፡ ተዓይነ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኆኅተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: And Moses did as the Lord appointed him, and he assembled the congregation at the door of the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: And Moses did as the Lord appointed him, and he assembled the congregation at the door of the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.ron: Şi a făcut Moise aşa cum îi poruncise Domnul şi a adunat obştea la uşa cortului adunării.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησε Μωυσῆς ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν αὐτῷ Κύριος· καὶ ἐξεκκλησίασε τὴν συναγωγὴν ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለተዓይን ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ቃል ፡ ዘአዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ትግበሩ ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to the congregation, This is the thing which the Lord has commanded you to do.

translations.lxx: And Moses said to the congregation, This is the thing which the Lord has commanded you to do.
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.
translations.ron: După aceea a zis Moise către obşte: "Iată ce porunceşte Domnul să se facă!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Μωυσῆς τῇ συναγωγῇ, τοῦτό ἐστι τὸ ῥῆμα, ὃ ἐνετείλατο Κύριος ποιῆσαι.

verses.geez: ወነሥኦሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወለደቂቁ ፡ ወኀፀቦሙ ፡ በማይ ።
verses.translation: And Moses brought nigh Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water,

translations.lxx: And Moses brought nigh Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water,
translations.kjv: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
translations.ron: Deci a adus Moise pe Aaron şi pe fiii lui şi i-a spălat cu apă:
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήνεγκε Μωυσῆς τὸν Ἀαρὼν, καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔλουσεν αὐτοὺς ὕδατι.

verses.geez:
ወአልበሶ ፡ አልባሰ ፡ ወአቅነቶ ፡ ቅናተ ፡ ወአልበሶ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ህጶዲጤ ፡ ወወደየ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ መትከፍት ፡
                  ወአቅነቶ ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ግብረታ ፡ ለልብሰ ፡ መትከፍት ፡ ወአሠራ ፡ ቦቱ ።
verses.translation: and put on him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the tunic, and put on him the ephod;

translations.lxx: and put on him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the tunic, and put on him the ephod;
translations.kjv: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.
translations.ron: Apoi a îmbrăcat pe Aaron cu hitonul, l-a încins cu brâul, l-a îmbrăcat cu meilul, i-a pus efodul, l-a încins cu cingătoarea efodului şi i-a strâns cu ea efodul;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐνέδυσεν αὐτὸν τὸν χιτῶνα, καὶ ἔζωσεν αὐτὸν τὴν ζώνην, καὶ ἐνέδυσεν αὐτὸν τὸν ὑποδύτην, καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπʼ αὐτὸν τὴν ἐπωμίδα.

verses.geez: ወወደየ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ሎግዮን ፡ ወወደየ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ሎግዮን ፡ ዘተአምር ፡ ወዘጽድቅ ።
verses.translation: and girded him with a girdle according to the make of the ephod, and clasped him closely with it: and put upon it the oracle, and put upon the oracle the Manifestation and the Truth.

translations.lxx: and girded him with a girdle according to the make of the ephod, and clasped him closely with it: and put upon it the oracle, and put upon the oracle the Manifestation and the Truth.
translations.kjv: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
translations.ron: După aceea i-a pus hoşenul şi în hoşen i-a pus Urim şi Tumim,
translations.grk: Καὶ συνέζωσεν αὐτὸν κατὰ τὴν ποίησιν τῆς ἐπωμίδος, καὶ συνέσφιγξεν αὐτὸν ἐν αὐτῇ· καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπʼ αὐτὴν τὸ λογεῖον, καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τὸ λογεῖον τὴν δήλωσιν καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειαν.

verses.geez:
ወወደየ ፡ አክሊለ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ርእሱ ፡ ወወደየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አክሊል ፡ መንገለ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ቈጽለ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ቅዱስ
                  ፡ ዘቅድሳት ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And he put the mitre on his head, and put upon the mitre in front the golden plate, the most holy thing, as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: And he put the mitre on his head, and put upon the mitre in front the golden plate, the most holy thing, as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.ron: Iar pe cap i-a pus chidarul şi la chidar, în partea lui de dinainte, i-a prins tăbliţa cea de aur, diadema sfinţeniei, cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπέθηκε τὴν μίτραν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τὴν μίτραν κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ τὸ πέταλον τὸ χρυσοῦν τὸ καθηγιασμένον ἅγιον, ὃν τρόπον συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez: ወነሥአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ቅብእ ፡ ዘይቀብኡ ።
verses.translation: And Moses took of the anointing oil,

translations.lxx: And Moses took of the anointing oil,
translations.kjv: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.
translations.ron: Apoi a luat Moise mirul de miruit şi a miruit cortul şi toate cele din el şi le-a sfinţit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔλαβε Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐλαίου τῆς χρίσεως,

verses.geez:
ወነዝኀ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ስብዕ ፡ ወቀብኦ ፡ ለምሥዋዕ ፡ ወቀደሶ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ንዋዮ ፡ ወማዕከከኒ ፡
                  ወመንበሮ ፡ ወቀደሳ ፡ ወቀብኣ ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ ወቀደሳ ፡ ወለኵሉ ፡ ንዋያ ።
verses.translation: and sprinkled of it seven times on the altar; and anointed the altar, and hallowed it, and all things on it, and the laver, and its foot, and sanctified them; and anointed the tabernacle and all its furniture, and hallowed it.

translations.lxx: and sprinkled of it seven times on the altar; and anointed the altar, and hallowed it, and all things on it, and the laver, and its foot, and sanctified them; and anointed the tabernacle and all its furniture, and hallowed it.
translations.kjv: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.
translations.ron: A stropit cu el de şapte ori asupra jertfelnicului şi a miruit jertfelnicul şi toate obiectele lui, baia şi căpătâiul ei şi le-a sfinţit.
translations.grk: καὶ ἔῤῥανεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον ἑπτάκις· καὶ ἔχρισε τὸ θυσιαστήριον, καὶ ἡγίασεν αὐτὸ, καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτῷ, καὶ τὸν λουτῆρα, καὶ τὴν βάσιν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἡγίασεν αὐτά· καὶ ἔχρισε τὴν σκηνὴν, καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς, καὶ ἡγίασεν αὐτήν.

verses.geez: ወከዐወ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ እምነ ፡ ቅብእ ፡ ዘይትቀብኡ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወቀብ[ኦ] ፡ ወቀደ[ሶ] ።
verses.translation: And Moses poured of the anointing oil on the head of Aaron; and he anointed him and sanctified him.

translations.lxx: And Moses poured of the anointing oil on the head of Aaron; and he anointed him and sanctified him.
translations.kjv: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
translations.ron: După aceea a turnat Moise mir pe capul lui Aaron şi l-a uns şi l-a sfinţit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπέχεε Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐλαίου τῆς χρίσεως ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Ἀαρών· καὶ ἔχρισεν αὐτὸν, καὶ ἡγίασεν αὐτόν.

verses.geez:
ወአምጽኦሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወአልበሶሙ ፡ አልባሰ ፡ ወአቅነቶሙ ፡ ቅናታተ ፡ ወወደየ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ ቂዳርሰ
                  ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And Moses brought the sons of Aaron near, and put on them coats and girded them with girdles, and put on them bonnets, as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: And Moses brought the sons of Aaron near, and put on them coats and girded them with girdles, and put on them bonnets, as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.ron: Şi a adus Moise pe fiii lui Aaron, i-a îmbrăcat cu hitoane, i-a încins cu brâie şi le-a pus turbane, cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήγαγε Μωυσῆς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἀαρὼν, καὶ ἐνέδυσεν αὐτοὺς χιτῶνας, καὶ ἔζωσεν αὐτοὺς ζώνας, καὶ περιέθηκεν αὐτοῖς κιδάρεις, καθάπερ συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez:
ወአምጽአ ፡ ላህመ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ወወደዩ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወደቂቁ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ርእሱ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ላህም
                  ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ።
verses.translation: And Moses brought near the calf for the sin-offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the calf of the sin-offering.

translations.lxx: And Moses brought near the calf for the sin-offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the calf of the sin-offering.
translations.kjv: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
translations.ron: Apoi a adus Moise viţelul cel de jertfă pentru păcat, iar Aaron şi fiii lui şi-au pus mâinile pe capul viţelului de jertfă pentru păcat;
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήγαγε Μωυσῆς τὸν μόσχον τὸν περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας· καὶ ἐπέθηκεν Ἀαρὼν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν τοῦ μόσχου τοῦ τῆς ἁμαρτίας.

verses.geez:
ወጠብሕዎ ፡ ወነሥአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ደሙ ፡ ወወደየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አቅርንተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐውዱ ፡ በአጽባዕቱ
                  ፡ ወአንጽሐ ፡ ለምሥዋዕ ፡ ወከዐወ ፡ ደሞ ፡ ኀበ ፡ መንበረ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወቀደሰ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያስተስሪ ፡ ቦቱ ።
verses.translation: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar round about with his finger; and he purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement upon it.

translations.lxx: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar round about with his finger; and he purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement upon it.
translations.kjv: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
translations.ron: Şi l-a junghiat Moise şi a luat din sânge şi cu degetul său a pus pe coarnele jertfelnicului de toate părţile şi a curăţit jertfelnicul, iar celălalt sânge l-a turnat jos lângă jertfelnic şi a sfinţit jertfelnicul ca să fie curat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσφαξεν αὐτόν· καὶ ἔλαβε Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος, καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τὰ κέρατα τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου κύκλῳ τῷ δακτύλῳ, καὶ ἐκαθάρισε τὸ θυσιαστήριον· καὶ τὸ αἷμα ἐξέχεεν ἐπὶ τὴν βάσιν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου, καὶ ἡγίασεν αὐτὸ, τοῦ ἐξιλάσασθαι ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ሥብሐ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ውስጡ ፡ ወከብዶ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትንእስ ፡ ወክልኤሆን ፡ ኵለያቲሁ ፡ ወሥብሐ
                  ፡ ዘላዕሌሆን ፡ ወወደዮ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ።
verses.translation: And Moses took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the lobe on the liver, and both the kidneys, and the fat that was upon them, and Moses offered them on the altar.

translations.lxx: And Moses took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the lobe on the liver, and both the kidneys, and the fat that was upon them, and Moses offered them on the altar.
translations.kjv: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.
translations.ron: A luat apoi Moise toată grăsimea de pe măruntaie, seul de pe ficat, amândoi rărunchii şi grăsimea lor, şi le-a ars pe jertfelnic.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔλαβε Μωυσῆς πᾶν τὸ στέαρ τὸ ἐπὶ τῶν ἐνδοσθίων, καὶ τὸν λοβὸν τὸν ἐπὶ τοῦ ἥπατος, καὶ ἀμφοτέρους τοὺς νεφροὺς, καὶ τὸ στέαρ τὸ ἐπʼ αὐτῶν, καὶ ἀνήνεγκε Μωυσῆς ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον.

verses.geez:
ወላህ[መ]ኒ ፡ ወማእሶኒ ፡ ወሥጋሁኒ ፡ ወካዕሴሁኒ ፡ ወአውዐዮ ፡ በእሳት ፡ አፍአ ፡ እምትዕይንት ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: But the calf, and his hide, and his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp, as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: But the calf, and his hide, and his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp, as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.ron: Iar viţelul, pielea lui, carnea lui şi necurăţenia lui, le-a ars cu foc afară din tabără, cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸν μόσχον, καὶ τὴν βύρσαν αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ κρέα αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὴν κόπρον αὐτοῦ, κατέκαυσεν αὐτὰ πυρὶ ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς, ὃν τρόπον συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez:
ወአምጽአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በግዐ ፡ ዘመሥዋዕት ፡ ወወደዩ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወደቂቁ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ርእሱ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ በግዕ
                  ።
verses.translation: And Moses brought near the ram for a whole-burnt-offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram. And Moses slew the ram: and Moses poured the blood on the altar round about.

translations.lxx: And Moses brought near the ram for a whole-burnt-offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram. And Moses slew the ram: and Moses poured the blood on the altar round about.
translations.kjv: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
translations.ron: Apoi Moise a adus berbecul cel pentru ardere de tot, iar Aaron şi fiii lui şi-au pus mâinile pe capul berbecului.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήγαγε Μωυσῆς τὸν κριὸν τὸν εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα· καὶ ἐπέθηκεν Ἀαρὼν καὶ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν τοῦ κριοῦ. Καὶ ἔσφαξε Μωυσῆς τὸν κριόν· καὶ προσέχεε Μωυσῆς τὸ αἷμα ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον κύκλῳ.

verses.geez: ወጠብሖ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ በግዕ ፡ ወከዐወ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ደሞ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐውደ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ።
verses.translation: And he divided the ram by its limbs, and Moses offered the head, and the limbs, and the fat; and he washed the belly and the feet with water.

translations.lxx: And he divided the ram by its limbs, and Moses offered the head, and the limbs, and the fat; and he washed the belly and the feet with water.
translations.kjv: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
translations.ron: Şi apoi a junghiat Moise berbecul şi a stropit cu sânge jertfelnicul de jur împrejur.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸν κριὸν ἐκρεανόμησε κατὰ μέλη· καὶ ἀνήνεγκε Μωυσῆς τὴν κεφαλὴν, καὶ τὰ μέλη, καὶ τὸ στέαρ· καὶ τὴν κοιλίαν, καὶ τοὺς πόδας ἔπλυνεν ὕδατι.

verses.geez: ወመተሮ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ በግዕ ፡ በበአባላቱ ፡ ወወደየ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ርእሶ ፡ ወአባላቶ ፡ ወሥብሖ ።
verses.translation: And Moses offered up the whole ram on the altar: it is a whole-burnt-offering for a sweet-smelling savour; it is a burnt-offering to the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: And Moses offered up the whole ram on the altar: it is a whole-burnt-offering for a sweet-smelling savour; it is a burnt-offering to the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
translations.ron: A tăiat apoi berbecul în bucăţi şi a adus Moise bucăţile, căpăţâna şi grăsimea, iar măruntaiele şi picioarele le-a spălat cu apă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνήνεγκε Μωυσῆς ὅλον τὸν κριὸν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον· ὁλοκαύτωμά ἐστιν εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας· κάρπωμά ἐστι τῷ Κυρίῳ, καθάπερ ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez:
ወከርሦ ፡ ወእገሪሁኒ ፡ ኀፀበ ፡ በማይ ፡ ወወደዮ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ በግዖ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ እስመ ፡ መሥዋዕት ፡
                  ውእቱ ፡ ዘመዐዛ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ወቍርባን ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And Moses brought the second ram, the ram of consecration, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram, and he slew him;

translations.lxx: And Moses brought the second ram, the ram of consecration, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram, and he slew him;
translations.kjv: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.ron: Şi a ars Moise tot berbecul pe jertfelnic; aceasta era ardere de tot spre mireasmă plăcută, aceasta era jertfă Domnului, cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήγαγε Μωυσῆς τὸν κριὸν τὸν δεύτερον, κριὸν τελειώσεως· καὶ ἐπέθηκεν Ἀαρὼν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν τοῦ κριοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወአምጽአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በግዐ ፡ ካልአ ፡ በግዕ ፡ ዘፍጻሜ ፡ ወወደዩ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወደቂቁ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ርእሱ ፡
                  ለውእቱ ፡ በግዕ ።
verses.translation: and Moses took of his blood, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.

translations.lxx: and Moses took of his blood, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.
translations.kjv: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
translations.ron: După aceea a adus Moise al doilea berbec, berbecul cel pentru sfinţire, şi şi-au pus Aaron şi fiii lui mâinile pe capul berbecului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσφαξεν αὐτόν· καὶ ἔλαβε Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τὸν λοβὸν τοῦ ὠτὸς Ἀαρὼν τοῦ δεξιοῦ, καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τῆς χειρὸς τῆς δεξιᾶς, καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τοῦ ποδὸς τοῦ δεξιοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወጠብሕዎ ፡ ወነሥአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ደሙ ፡ ወወደየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከተማ ፡ እዝኑ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ እንተ ፡ የማን ፡
                  ወውስተ ፡ ከተማ ፡ አጻብዐ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ እንተ ፡ የማን ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ከተማ ፡ አጻብዐ ፡ እግሩ ፡ እንተ ፡ የማን ።
verses.translation: And Moses brought near the sons of Aaron; and Moses put of the blood on the tips of their right ears, and on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the great toes of their right feet, and Moses poured out the blood on the altar round about.

translations.lxx: And Moses brought near the sons of Aaron; and Moses put of the blood on the tips of their right ears, and on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the great toes of their right feet, and Moses poured out the blood on the altar round about.
translations.kjv: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
translations.ron: Şi junghiindu-l, Moise a luat din sângele lui şi a pus pe vârful urechii drepte a lui Aaron, pe degetul cel mare de la mâna dreaptă a lui şi pe degetul cel mare de la piciorul drept al lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήγαγε Μωυσῆς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἀαρών· καὶ ἐπέθηκε Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος ἐπὶ τοὺς λοβοὺς τῶν ὤτων τῶν δεξιῶν, καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ἄκρα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν τῶν δεξιῶν· καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ἄκρα τῶν ποδῶν αὐτῶν τῶν δεξιῶν· καὶ προσέχεε Μωυσῆς τὸ αἷμα ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον κύκλῳ.

verses.geez:
ወአምጽኦሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወወደየ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ደም ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከተማ ፡ እዘኒሆሙ ፡
                  ዘየማን ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ከተማ ፡ [አጻብዐ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ፡ ዘየማን ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ከተማ ፡ አጻብዐ ፡] እገሪሆሙ ፡ ዘየማን ፡
                  ወከዐዎ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ደም ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐውደ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ።
verses.translation: And he took the fat, and the rump, and the fat on the belly, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder.

translations.lxx: And he took the fat, and the rump, and the fat on the belly, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder.
translations.kjv: And he brought Aaron’s sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
translations.ron: Apoi a adus Moise pe fiii lui Aaron şi a pus sânge pe vârful urechilor drepte ale lor, pe degetul cel mare de la mâinile drepte ale lor şi pe degetul cel mare de la picioarele drepte ale lor; şi a stropit Moise jertfelnicul cu sânge de jur împrejur.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔλαβε τὸ στέαρ, καὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν, καὶ τὸ στέαρ τὸ ἐπὶ τῆς κοιλίας, καὶ τὸν λοβὸν τοῦ ἥπατος, καὶ τοὺς δύο νεφροὺς, καὶ τὸ στέαρ τὸ ἐπʼ αὐτῶν, καὶ τὸν βραχίονα τὸν δεξιόν.

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ሥብሖ ፡ ወሐቌሁ ፡ ወሥብሐ ፡ ከርሡ ፡ ወከብዶ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትንእስ ፡ ወክልኤሆን ፡ ኵለያቲሁ ፡ ወሥብሐ
                  ፡ ዘላዕሌሆን ፡ ወአገዳሁ ፡ ዘየማን ።
verses.translation: And from the basket of consecration, which was before the Lord, he also took one unleavened loaf, and one loaf made with oil, and one cake; and put them upon the fat, and the right shoulder:

translations.lxx: And from the basket of consecration, which was before the Lord, he also took one unleavened loaf, and one loaf made with oil, and one cake; and put them upon the fat, and the right shoulder:
translations.kjv: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:
translations.ron: După aceea a luat Moise grăsimea şi coada, toată grăsimea de pe măruntaie, seul de pe ficat, amândoi rărunchii, grăsimea lor şi şoldul drept;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ κανοῦ τῆς τελειώσεως, τοῦ ὄντος ἔναντι Κυρίου, καὶ ἔλαβεν ἄρτον ἕνα ἄζυμον, καὶ ἄρτον ἐξ ἐλαίου ἕνα, καὶ λάγανον ἓν, καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τὸ στέαρ, καὶ τὸν βραχίονα τὸν δεξιόν.

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ ፡ እመስፈርት ፡ ዘፍጻሜ ፡ ዘሀሎ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኅብስተ ፡ ናእት ፡ አሐተ ፡ ወኅብስተ ፡ ዘበቅብእ ፡
                  አሐተ ፡ ወጸሪቀተ ፡ አሐተ ፡ ወወደዮ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ሥብሕ ፡ ወዲበ ፡ አገዳ ፡ ዘየማን ።
verses.translation: and put them all on the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons, and offered them up for a wave-offering before the Lord.

translations.lxx: and put them all on the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons, and offered them up for a wave-offering before the Lord.
translations.kjv: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:
translations.ron: Iar din panerul cu pâinile punerii înaintea Domnului a luat o azimă, o pâine cu untdelemn şi turtă şi le-a aşezat peste grăsime şi peste şoldul drept;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἅπαντα ἐπὶ τὰς χεῖρας Ἀαρὼν, καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς χεῖρας τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν αὐτὰ ἀφαίρεμα ἔναντι Κυρίου.

verses.geez: ወአንበሮ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደወ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወውስተ ፡ እደወ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ወአብእዎ ፡ መባአ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Moses took them at their hands, and Moses offered them on the altar, on the whole-burnt-offering of consecration, which is a smell of sweet savour: it is a burnt-offering to the Lord.

translations.lxx: And Moses took them at their hands, and Moses offered them on the altar, on the whole-burnt-offering of consecration, which is a smell of sweet savour: it is a burnt-offering to the Lord.
translations.kjv: And he put all upon Aaron’s hands, and upon his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.
translations.ron: Şi toate acestea le-a pus pe mâinile lui Aaron şi pe mâinile fiilor săi şi le-au dus legănându-le înaintea feţei Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔλαβε Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν αὐτὰ Μωυσῆς ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον, ἐπὶ τὸ ὁλοκαύτωμα τῆς τελειώσεως, ὅ ἐστι ὀσμὴ εὐωδίας· κάρπωμά ἐστιν τῷ Κυρίῳ.

verses.geez:
ወነሥኦ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ፡ ወወደዮ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ዲበ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ፍጻሜ ፡ ቍርባን ፡ ዘመዐዛ
                  ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Moses took the breast, and separated it for a heave-offering before the Lord, from the ram of consecration; and it became Moses' portion, as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: And Moses took the breast, and separated it for a heave-offering before the Lord, from the ram of consecration; and it became Moses' portion, as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
translations.ron: Apoi a luat Moise acestea din mâinile lor şi le-a ars pe jertfelnic ardere de tot; aceasta a fost jertfa de sfinţire, mireasmă plăcută, jertfă Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ λαβὼν Μωυσῆς τὸ στηθύνιον, ἀφεῖλεν αὐτὸ ἐπίθεμα ἔναντι Κυρίου, ἀπὸ τοῦ κριοῦ τῆς τελειώσεως· καὶ ἐγένετο Μωυσῇ ἐν μεριδι, καθὰ ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ተላዐ ፡ ወመተረ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይደዮ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምነ ፡ በግዕ ፡ ዘፍጻሜ ፡ ወኮነ ፡
                  ክፍሉ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood that was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, and on his garments, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him.

translations.lxx: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood that was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, and on his garments, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him.
translations.kjv: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses’ part; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.ron: Luând apoi pieptul, Moise l-a adus, legănându-l înaintea feţei Domnului; aceasta era partea lui Moise din berbecul sfinţirii, cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔλαβε Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐλαίου τῆς χρίσεως, καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ ἐπὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου, καὶ προσέῤῥνεν ἐπὶ Ἀαρὼν, καὶ τὰς στολὰς αὐτοῦ, καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰς στολὰς τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ μετʼ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ እምነ ፡ ቅብእ ፡ ዘይቀብኡ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ደም ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወነዝኀ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ አሮን ፡
                  ወላዕለ ፡ አልባሲሁ ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ አልባሰ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ወቀደሶ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወለአልባሲሁ ፡
                  ወለደቂቁ ፡ ወለአልባሰ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ምስሌሁ ።
verses.translation: And he sanctified Aaron and his garments, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him.

translations.lxx: And he sanctified Aaron and his garments, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him.
translations.kjv: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons’ garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
translations.ron: Apoi a luat Moise mir de miruit şi sânge de lângă jertfelnic şi a stropit pe Aaron, veşmintele lui, pe fiii lui şi veşmintele fiilor lui împreună cu el; şi aşa a sfinţit pe Aaron şi veşmintele lui şi, împreună cu el, şi pe fiii lui şi veşmintele fiilor lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἡγίασεν Ἀαρὼν, καὶ τὰς στολάς αὐτοῦ, καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰς στολὰς τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ μετʼ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወለደቂቁ ፡ አብስሉ ፡ ውእተ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ በዐጸደ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ በመካን ፡ ቅዱስ
                  ፡ ወበህየ ፡ ብልዕዎ ፡ ወኅብስተኒ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ መስፈርት ፡ ዘፍጻሜ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዘኒ ፡ ወይቤለኒ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወደቂቁ ፡
                  ይብልዕዎ ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh in the tent of the tabernacle of witness in the holy place; and there ye shall eat it and the loaves in the basket of consecration, as it has been appointed me, the Lord saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat them.

translations.lxx: And Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh in the tent of the tabernacle of witness in the holy place; and there ye shall eat it and the loaves in the basket of consecration, as it has been appointed me, the Lord saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat them.
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
translations.ron: Apoi a zis Moise către Aaron şi către fiii lui: "Fierbeţi carnea la intrarea cortului adunării şi acolo s-o mâncaţi cu pâinea cea din panerul sfinţirii, după cum mi s-a poruncit mie şi mi s-a zis: "Aaron şi fiii lui s-o mănânce!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Μωυσῆς πρὸς Ἀαρὼν, καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ, ἑψήσατε τὰ κρέα ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ· καὶ ἐκεῖ φάγεσθε αὐτὰ, καὶ τοὺς ἄρτους τοὺς ἐν τῷ κανῷ τῆς τελειώσεως, ὃν τρόπον συντέτακταί μοι, λέγων, Ἀαρὼν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ φάγονται αὐτά.

verses.geez: ወዘተርፈ ፡ እምሥጋ ፡ ወእምኅብስት ፡ በእሳት ፡ አውዕይዎ ።
verses.translation: And that which is left of the flesh and of the loaves burn ye with fire.

translations.lxx: And that which is left of the flesh and of the loaves burn ye with fire.
translations.kjv: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
translations.ron: Iar rămăşiţele de carne şi de pâine să le ardeţi cu foc.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸ καταλειφθὲν τῶν κρεῶν καὶ τῶν ἄρτων ἐν πυρὶ κατακαύσατε.

verses.geez:
ወኢትወጽኡ ፡ እምኆኅተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ሰቡዐ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ [እስከ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ትፌጽሙ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ፍጻሜክሙ ፡
                  እስመ ፡ ሰቡዐ ፡ ዕለተ ፡] ይፌጽማ ፡ እደዊክሙ ፤
verses.translation: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of witness for seven days, until the day be fulfilled, the day of your consecration; for in seven days shall he consecrate you,

translations.lxx: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of witness for seven days, until the day be fulfilled, the day of your consecration; for in seven days shall he consecrate you,
translations.kjv: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.
translations.ron: Şapte zile să nu vă depărtaţi de la uşa cortului adunării, până se vor împlini zilele sfinţirii voastre, că sfinţirea voastră trebuie să se săvârşească în şapte zile.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου οὐκ ἐξελεύσεσθε ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας, ἕως ἡμέρα πληρωθῇ, ἡμέρα τελειώσεως ὑμῶν· ἑπτὰ γὰρ ἡμέρας τελειώσει τὰς χεῖρας ὑμῶν.

verses.geez: በከመ ፡ ገብረ ፡ በይእቲ ፡ ዕለት ፡ እንተ ፡ አዘዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበሩ ፡ በዘ ፡ ያስተሰርዩ ፡ ለክሙ ።
verses.translation: as he did in this day on which the Lord commanded me to do so, to make an atonement for you.

translations.lxx: as he did in this day on which the Lord commanded me to do so, to make an atonement for you.
translations.kjv: As he hath done this day, so the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.
translations.ron: Cum s-a făcut astăzi, aşa a poruncit Domnul să se facă pentru curăţirea voastră şi în celelalte zile.
translations.grk: Καθάπερ ἐποίησεν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ, ᾗ ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τοῦ ποιῆσαι, ὥστε ἐξιλάσασθαι περὶ ὑμῶν.

verses.geez:
ወትነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኆኅተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ሰቡዐ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ሌሊተ ፡ ወመዓልተ ፡ ወዕቀቡ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡
                  ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትሙቱ ፡ እስመ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ አዘዘኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And ye shall remain seven days at the door of the tabernacle of witness, day and night; ye shall observe the ordinances of the Lord, that ye die not; for so has the Lord God commanded me.

translations.lxx: And ye shall remain seven days at the door of the tabernacle of witness, day and night; ye shall observe the ordinances of the Lord, that ye die not; for so has the Lord God commanded me.
translations.kjv: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
translations.ron: La uşa cortului adunării veţi şedea ziua şi noaptea timp de şapte zile şi veţi fi de strajă la Domnul, ca să nu muriţi, că aşa mi s-a poruncit mie de la Domnul Dumnezeu".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καθήσεσθε ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας, ἡμέραν καὶ νύκτα· φυλάξεσθε τὰ φυλάγματα Κυρίου, ἵνα μὴ ἀποθάνητε· οὕτω γὰρ ἐνετείλατό μοι Κύριος ὁ Θεός.

verses.geez: ወገብሩ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወደቂቁ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ዘአዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And Aaron and his sons performed all these commands which the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: And Aaron and his sons performed all these commands which the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
translations.ron: Şi au împlinit Aaron şi fiii lui toate rânduielile, câte le poruncise Domnul prin Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησεν Ἀαρὼν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ πάντας τοὺς λόγους, οὓς συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.
